lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The fourth floor is an allocation office. Not one like yours. Yours — the symmetric desks, the corridor lit end to end, the bench by the lift with the worn patch on it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: He has read my file. Of course he has read my file. It is the only thing about me that exists anywhere in this system, and he has had it for as long as I have had a desk.
